goalOneSentence: Identify and fix three stacked silent assertion failures that produce a false-green QaaS suite.
nonGoals: adding new transactions or data sources
portContract: This sprint's mocker MUST listen on HTTP port 8261. Every runner Transaction MUST target http://127.0.0.1:8261. Do NOT use any other port.

tasks.title: Diagnose all three silent failures, write DIAGNOSIS.md, and fix Runner/test.qaas.yaml
tasks.description: The seeded project (already present in your workspace) contains a Runner and Mocker that compile and run but produce a completely false-green result. The suite exits 0 and all assertions log PASS, yet no assertion actually checks anything. Three independent silent failures are present in Runner/test.qaas.yaml. Bug A (trap s13#13, vacuous HttpStatus): the AssertStatus assertion uses Assertion: HttpStatus with AssertionConfiguration.OutputNames: [TxOut], but the runner transaction is named Trans1 -- TxOut matches zero outputs so HttpStatus passes vacuously (the log reads 'All configured outputs arrived with status 200 (0 outputs checked)'). Bug B (trap s13#12, silently-ignored config key): the AssertCount assertion uses Assertion: HermeticByExpectedOutputCount with the config key ExpectedOutputCount: 1, but the real field name is ExpectedCount (see FB s09) -- unknown keys inside AssertionConfiguration are silently discarded, leaving the guard with no effective count constraint. Bug C (trap s13#13, vacuous hermetic guard): that same AssertCount assertion uses OutputNames: [TxOutX], which does not match any transaction output (the real output is Trans1), so the guard evaluates zero outputs and passes vacuously regardless of Bug B. Your task: (1) Write DIAGNOSIS.md that names all three bugs with the exact broken YAML key or field value for each, and cites s13#12 for the silently-ignored key and s13#13 for both vacuous-pass cases. (2) Fix Runner/test.qaas.yaml with exactly three changes: change OutputNames: [TxOut] to [Trans1] in AssertStatus; change the key ExpectedOutputCount to ExpectedCount in AssertCount; change OutputNames: [TxOutX] to [Trans1] in AssertCount. Do not change the mocker, the port (8261), the route (status), or any transaction definitions.

verify.cmd: $m = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList 'run','-c','Release','--','run','test.mocker.yaml' -WorkingDirectory '..\Mocker' -PassThru; $ok = $false; foreach ($i in 1..40) { try { (New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1', 8261)).Close(); $ok = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep 2 } }; if (-not $ok) { Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force; exit 9 }; dotnet run -c Release -- run test.qaas.yaml; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code

acceptanceCriteria: DIAGNOSIS.md exists and names all three bugs with exact broken key or output-name for each
DIAGNOSIS.md cites s13#12 for the silently-ignored key and s13#13 for the vacuous-pass cases
E2E runs green after fixes (exactly 1 output genuinely asserted)
rubric: All three bugs identified by exact YAML field with correct s13 citations
ExpectedOutputCount removed and replaced with ExpectedCount in yaml
Both OutputNames corrected to [Trans1] in yaml
E2E still exits 0 with the guard now enforcing count and the HttpStatus checking real outputs
failureModes: Accepting the exit-0 run as genuinely passing without investigating
Fixing only one or two of the three bugs and missing the others
Renaming ExpectedOutputCount to a different wrong key instead of ExpectedCount
Changing the port (8261), route (status), or mocker stub
